# TimGM6mb SoundFont

`TimGM6mb.sf2` is Tim Brechbill's General MIDI SoundFont, historically distributed
with MuseScore 1. The checked-in file is an unmodified copy of the 5,969,788-byte
asset archived at:

<https://github.com/guitarpick/soundfonts/blob/98b6eeb8aa0aaddf703ef7bb46ed6b40fcf5d010/Muscore%201/TimGM6mb.sf2>

The contemporaneous attribution supplied by downstream distributors identifies
Tim Brechbill as the author and the GNU General Public License as the license:

<https://github.com/kujirahand/picosakura/blob/1802e1aa1140da272ba3bbb897a48b1d2d8154b0/synth/fonts/TimGM6mb.sf2.LICENSE.txt>

The original MuseScore attribution discussion is archived at
<https://musescore.org/en/node/1463#comment-9161>.

Redistribution is compatible with ShoopDaLoop's GPL distribution. Packages that
contain this embedded asset must retain this notice and ShoopDaLoop's GPL text.
